# EURAMAS

> The European Association for Multi-Agent Systems (EURAMAS) is a nonprofit founded in 2009 to promote European science and technology in multi-agent systems.

## Website

- [Home](https://euramas.github.io/): Association overview and event announcements.
- [Board members](https://euramas.github.io/board-members.html): Officers, directors, and advisory board.
- [Objectives and activities](https://euramas.github.io/objectives-and-activities.html): Mission, designated events, organizer guidelines, articles, and bylaws.
- [Past events](https://euramas.github.io/past-events.html): Archive of EUMAS conferences and workshops and EASSS summer schools.
